svg.title: Foundation model lifecycle — light
svg.text: Foundation model → LoRA adaptation → compact adapter checkpoint → restoration
DeepMTP foundation-model lifecycle. Compact checkpoints reference pinned base weights instead of storing them.

g.text: Pinned Hub example; local snapshots are also supported
read-only · loaded by revision at restore time
The compact checkpoint records this model and tokenizer
identity instead of copying the base tensors.
LoRA on selected projections + trainable task head
Gradients reach only the LoRA matrices and the task-specific
layers; the backbone stays bit-identical to its pinned revision.
Adapters, task weights and provenance only
required state files verified on load
Compact archive + the recorded base identity
adapters attached · task head loaded · hashes verified
Reproducible for inference and as a warm start for further
training. It is not an exact resume of an interrupted run —
no optimizer, scheduler or data-loader state is carried.
LoRA + task weights, base by reference
Either artefact can be logged, versioned, lineage-tracked and pulled back by version.
The compact archive resolves its base from the recorded Hub revision or user-managed local snapshot.
